_note: One Baidu photo of the terminal approach joins the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

sha-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，上海虹桥国际机场（SHA）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
sha-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport (SHA) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

sha-baidu-1.webp.zh: 从进场高架望向上海虹桥机场航站楼，楼顶红色的「虹橋機場」字样与一大片积云同框。
sha-baidu-1.webp.en: Shanghai Hongqiao's terminal seen from the approach road, its red '虹橋機場' rooftop letters backed by towering clouds.
